name: Historian Dr Aldred

intro.text: The Lindisfarne Gospels were made around 715 by a monk named Eadfrith. That is the only fact I need. Please, take your time with the rest.

win: A scholarly victory. I shall write it up in tiny, beautiful letters.
after: Aldred was the monk who, two hundred years later, added the English translation between the lines. It's the oldest English version of the Gospels. He's the original footnote.
